The following is a list of all of the English language home video releases of the twentieth season of {{aniseries|PTS}}, [[S20|Pokémon the Series: Sun & Moon]], in {{pmin|Australia}} and {{pmin|New Zealand}} ({{wp|DVD region code|DVD Region 4}}). ==Partial collections== Two Pokémon the Series: Sun & Moon Collections were released by {{wp|Beyond Home Entertainment}} in 2017 and 2018, containing the whole season between them. ===Pokémon the Series: Sun & Moon - Collection 1=== [[File:Sun and Moon Collection 1.png|thumb|Pokémon the Series: Sun & Moon - Collection 1]] Pokémon the Series: Sun & Moon - Collection 1 was released by {{wp|Beyond Home Entertainment}} in Australia on December 6, 2017 and in New Zealand on December 13, 2017. It contains three discs with 22 episodes across them combined. Its catalogue number is BHE7788. ====Contents==== {| class="roundy" style="margin:auto; text-align:center; background: #{{colorschemelight|Alola}}; border: 3px solid #{{colorschemedark|Alola}}" !
